messages:
Maya Patel: quick alignment needed on the new feature-gate 'response-routing-v2' — planning an A/B experiment + phased enable behind flag. want to lock audience splits and guardrails before i send the rollout PR.
Jon Alvarez: thumbs up. what audiences are we thinking?
Maya Patel: A: 5% new users; B: 10% returning light users; Control: rest. total exposed ~15% initially.
Sasha Li: are those buckets disjoint? potential overlap with existing rerank experiments?
Maya Patel: good q — we need disjointness. goal is no overlap with current reranker v3 or prefix-cache tests. i can add audience exclusion rules in the flag config.
Jon Alvarez: can we do an explicit hash key + namespace to guarantee non-overlap? e.g. `user_id % 1000` ranges.
Maya Patel: yes, plan to use `experiment_namespace: routing` and then ranges: A=0..49, B=50..149 (per-mille). Control = rest.
Liam O'Connor: guardrails? what metrics to watch to stop the experiment early?
Eva Gomez: primary metric = downstream routing accuracy (click-through on suggested completion). secondary = 95th latency and cost per token. stop rule if routing accuracy drops >2.5% relative or 95th latency regresses >50ms sustained for 10m.
Sasha Li: add error-rate guardrail too — if model fallback rate >1% then abort. also watch per-region skew (us-east vs eu-west).
Maya Patel: noted. i'll add these as automated alerts in console and a webhook to #incidents if triggered.
Ops Bot: deployment plan created: `routing-v2-experiment` flag (immutable root) -> rollout via toggles: stage=canary(15%) -> ramp(60%) -> full. manual pause at 60%.
Jon Alvarez: pinging @sasha and @liam for quick CR on flag gating logic in this PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/infra/pull/5443
Sasha Li: taking a look now. main ask: make the exclusion list explicit and include a simulated overlap test in CI that samples 100k user ids and asserts zero intersection with rerank experiments.
Maya Patel: good call. i'll add a CI job. can we also add a dashboard card for these slices?
Eva Gomez: i'll create a dashboard: routing_accuracy_by_slice, latency_p95_by_slice, fallback_rate_by_slice. set alert thresholds per the guardrails.
Liam O'Connor: quick note on sampling entropy: make sure split uses stable hashing on `uid_v2` not signup_time, else churn will move people between buckets.
Maya Patel: agreed — stable id used. also we should mark in the PR the planned rollback flag keys so SRE can flip quickly if incidents.
Jon Alvarez: LGTM from infra side if Sasha + Liam approve the exclusion CI.
Sasha Li: left a small comment on the PR about naming and test timeout. otherwise LGTM.
Maya Patel: thanks team. i'll update PR with exclusion CI + guardrail config and schedule a 1pm sync if anything spills over. @Ops Bot can you schedule the rollout for 3pm tomorrow?
Ops Bot: scheduled rollout for 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z into the `routing-v2-experiment` flag. notifications will post to #eng-platform and #incidents at each milestone. :rocket:
Jon Alvarez: one last ask — include an event tag in logs `experiment:routing_v2` so we can filter traces easily.
Maya Patel: done, adding tag and a short note to the playbook about rollback runbook and where to find dashboards.
Eva Gomez: i'll add the alert runbook steps.
Liam O'Connor: thanks — i'll be on standby for the 3pm rollout window.
Maya Patel: appreciated. I'll follow up once PR is updated.
